name: Kimber Sykes
rolesLine: Executive Producer, Production Manager and Technical Director
oneLiner: Kimber Sykes is a London-based freelance Executive Producer, Production Manager and Technical Director, delivering large-scale corporate events worldwide for agencies and brands across B2B tech conferences, consumer brand activations and sports sponsorship programmes.
shortLine: Freelance Executive Producer, Production Manager and Technical Director. Based in London, working worldwide.
metaDescription: London-based freelance Executive Producer, Production Manager and Technical Director for tech conferences, brand activations and sports sponsorship, worldwide.
knowsAbout: Show flow and run of show

career.role: Executive Producer, Senior Production Manager, Technical Director and Project Lead
career.summary: Engaged by agencies including Wonder, INVNT, Jack Morton, Amplify, Curiious, Octagon, Imagination and BMF to lead production on conferences, brand activations and sports sponsorship programmes.

Project led the Emirates Aviation Experience at Greenwich Peninsula with a hand-built team of 40 (c. GBP 7 million), and worked across Emirates' global sports sponsorship programme. Clients included Emirates, NTT Data, dnata, Bentley, DP World, Intercontinental Hotels and Jumeirah Hotels.
Produced the live programme for Rizlab, Experiments in Music, for Rizla.
Clients included American Express, B Braun, CBA, Jaguar, Pfizer, Sony and Telstra. Nominated for Meeting and Event Association Australian Young Professional of the Year 2010.
Founded a small business providing staffing support for the events industry.

services.name: Executive Production
services.intro: As Executive Producer, Kimber owns a project for the agency from brief to derig: the client relationship, budget, supplier network and freelance delivery team. He delivered Canva Studio in London from concept to delivery in six weeks.
included: Building and leading freelance production teams
services.typical: Brand and product launches, pop-ups and experiential activations, innovation and sustainability exhibits, and sports sponsorship activations.

services.name: Production Management
services.intro: As Senior Production Manager, Kimber runs production on site across large multi-room conferences, covering AV, staging, show flow, crew and contractors. He has led production on Google Cloud Summit London at Tobacco Dock for three consecutive years, with 2,500+ attendees and up to nine rooms running in parallel.
included: Production schedules, show flow and run of show
Crew and contractor management, including bespoke sign-in software for 1,000+ contractors
services.typical: Multi-room B2B conferences and summits, exhibitions and immersive fan experiences.

services.name: Technical Direction
services.intro: As Technical Director, Kimber keeps stages, broadcast feeds, AV and exhibition floors technically aligned and on schedule, working between the agency's creative team and its technical suppliers. Recent work includes Xerocon in Nashville, London and Denver for INVNT.
included: Technical support for overseas production teams
services.typical: Flagship conferences with multiple stages and broadcast, exhibition floors, and technology-led installations and projection.
